verdict.rationale: There are some signs of versioning. CLI and API responses carry a `schemaVersion` envelope (seen in docs and in keyless API/MCP error bodies), and process guides can be pinned to a positive-integer version. There is also a downloadable OpenAPI contract and a pinnable CLI version, though the probed OpenAPI paths returned 404. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy or explicit API version paths. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, explicit API versioning scheme (e.g., versioned endpoints or headers), a changelog or compatibility guarantees, and independent corroboration.
